sources.observation: Three groups of roof courses rise above the deeply framed and sealed doorway. The front stair serves the raised plinth.
The Nata Mandir stands separately with open sky above the pillars. The surviving main hall is taller than the low sanctuary remnants.

limitations: The native footprints control the plinths. Wheel offsets, shallow relief, pier profiles and the surviving western sanctuary walls use approximate photograph-based geometry.
The locally available DEM includes a raised surface over the temple. The platform datum uses adjacent ground samples, so the transition grade is approximate.
